claims.claim_text: The TruFor image-level manipulation score is 0.998.
claims.brief_justification: A reported numeric score; not checkable from the images.

claims.claim_text: This indicates a high likelihood of authenticity.
claims.brief_justification: The surfboard inside the annotated region differs between IMAGE A (dark rail with orange/red rail colouring) and IMAGE B (pale cream/white board), so altered content is present.

claims.claim_text: There is a localized region in the center.
claims.brief_justification: IMAGE C's thin white bar has ~40% of its area in the center cell with the remainder just crossing into center-right, bottom-center and bottom-right; IMAGE D's box sits on the centre cell's lower-right part.

claims.claim_text: That region has a high mean and max probability.
claims.brief_justification: Reported score values, not visually checkable.

claims.claim_text: This suggests the presence of a specific feature or object there.
claims.brief_justification: The annotated bar encloses a distinct object: the surfboard under the rider's feet.

claims.claim_text: The image shows a surfer on a wave.
claims.brief_justification: IMAGE A clearly shows a surfer riding the face of a breaking wave.

notes: Location, the presence of an object in the annotated region, and the surfer-on-a-wave description are corroborated. The authenticity conclusion is contradicted by the A-versus-B difference in the board that the annotated bar covers, and reading a 0.998 manipulation score as evidence of authenticity is internally inconsistent. The annotated region straddles four cells, with the center cell the largest share.
